source_text: Infans formatus — sensus perfectior; nondum formatus — inchoatio. Laedere catechumenos vel imperfectos grave est.
pass_a_gloss: Infant formed — sense more-perfect; not-yet formed — beginning. To-harm catechumens or imperfect-ones grave is.
pass_b_english: The formed child figures a more perfect understanding; the unformed, a beginning. To harm catechumens or the imperfect is a grave fault.
